reviews.text:
I met Valérie while looking for a trainer for my 4-month-old Akita Inu puppy. This breed requires constant socialization and training from a very young age. From the start, Valérie impressed us with her extensive knowledge of the canine world, across all breeds.

Her shop and expertise are invaluable. You can find all sorts of products there for chewing, training, and dog development. We particularly appreciated the toy library, which allows us to refresh the games every month and gradually increase their level of difficulty. This is a real asset for an Akita, an independent, intelligent dog that constantly needs mental stimulation.
Thank you, Valérie!
You don't own an Akita, you deserve one.

I preferred to wait a while before writing a review. Not that we weren't satisfied with the work done with Valérie—quite the contrary—but to let time do its work.

A year has passed, Coco celebrated her second birthday yesterday, and I can say without hesitation that Valérie is an exceptional trainer.

It wasn't just our dog who was trained, but also (and especially) her humans. Coco is now a perfectly balanced adult dog, playful, affectionate, and obedient, even if she's still a bit stubborn! But that's just her Staffie temperament... what can you do?

What strikes me most about her behavior today is her ability to interact with reactive dogs: she knows how to calm them down and communicate with them. How many times have I heard, "It's funny, she gets along so well with your dog, whereas usually it's not the case with others!"?

Thank you, Valérie, for your rigor, your professionalism, and your profound sensitivity towards dogs as well as humans. You taught us how to communicate with Coco, to feel each other, to connect. This isn't just successful training; it's also an opportunity for us humans to reconnect with our animal nature.

I highly recommend you!
This place has excellent dog training techniques! I recommend it for all dogs, adult or puppies.

A fantastic find!

There's an impressive selection of high-quality treats and chews, far exceeding what you'd find in a typical pet store. You can tell the products are carefully chosen, and the advice is truly excellent.

There's also a great selection of educational and puzzle toys to keep your dog entertained and engaged.

My dog ​​loves it, and I go back regularly. I highly recommend it!
A very friendly and helpful educator. Attentive. Well-stocked shop. Stop going to the big chains!
Excellent, I highly recommend it. I took puppy classes with Valérie, everything was perfect.

All the products sold in this shop make you want to buy them for your dog! Thanks to their toy rental system, I've been able to regularly introduce my dog ​​to new things.

There's also a wide selection of chews and treats that Maya loves. A fantastic shop with excellent advice; I highly recommend it!
Truly professional advice, a super friendly welcome, little Uzi is thrilled with her new toys haha! I highly recommend them 🙌 …
Passing through Marseille for a few days with my dog, I took the opportunity to say hello to Valerie. A superb welcome and a superb shop, a paradise for dogs 😊 Go there without hesitation! …
We adopted a dog, and it was our first experience with a canine. Valérie guided us with kindness and care. Her classes are clear, effective, and respectful. I highly recommend her.

A shop that never fails to surprise us with its wide selection, quality products, and diverse offerings to suit all dogs (and cats), not to mention Valérie's invaluable advice… Toys, activities, kibble, chew toys, proprioception sessions—there's something for everyone!
Great shop for our dogs. They have tons of training toys, and a trainer who helps you with your purchase. I highly recommend it.

I discovered this shop in November when I came to inquire about puppy classes for my dog, Nivah.
Valérie is very professional and gives excellent advice based on the breed, age, and temperament of the dog.

She has lots of chew toys that my dog ​​has had the chance to try out over time 😂
Accessories, equipment, enrichment games, training games, toys—you can find everything there.
A real treasure trove!

Thanks again, Valérie, for your time and advice since November!!
Excellent shop with a wide selection of healthy products adapted to each dog's dietary needs. They also offer monthly toy rentals to provide varied stimulation!
A dog lover's paradise, absolutely fantastic! I highly recommend it!

This is a superb shop for dogs, with a warm welcome and helpful staff. Valerie has a positive dog training method; she's the only person who has succeeded with my German Shepherd, Tolkien, in getting him to interact with other dogs. I highly recommend Canidelire; they are very professional.
We were very satisfied with Valerie's professionalism towards our tiny Chihuahua, "Vergio". Thank you.
Great shop with top-quality kibble and treats. A trainer on site is available to answer your questions with kindness. I highly recommend it.

I've been buying my dog's kibble from Camille Délire for two years now and I'm completely satisfied. The quality is excellent: my dog ​​has a beautiful coat and regular digestion. They provide friendly service and helpful advice — I highly recommend them.
You can find everything there, especially a professional guide that helps us choose the best one for our dog.
Great quality dog ​​toys, premium dog food, and invaluable advice. Thank you!
Excellent dog training center, the trainer Valérie is very professional. The Sunday classes next to Leclerc in Marseille are very convenient. Well done, keep up the good work!
Superb shop where you can find absolutely everything for your little one!
Friendly welcome, detailed advice, and a good selection, plus a little gift, I recommend it :)

I was blown away by Valérie's skills and extensive experience as a dog trainer. Watching training videos on YouTube isn't enough; only a face-to-face meeting can truly resolve issues. Pamela and I thank you!

A must-visit shop for dogs. I received excellent advice on choosing accessories thanks to the kindness and professionalism of the trainer. Her shop is full of toys and food! They have everything!!!
The welcome is warm. A real gem!!!

A wonderful establishment for our dogs. The training, nutrition, and feeding advice is very thorough.

A wide selection of products and toys...
The staff is attentive, doesn't push you to buy anything, and takes their time.

I highly recommend it!
Thank you for everything.
A great shop for our little ones, you can find lots of things there that make our friends happy, from the youngest to the oldest.

A passionate and true professional who can advise you on the best equipment for your dog :)

Valerie also offers positive reinforcement training classes! Between her teaching methods and her expert advice, you can trust her completely!
Ideal for your four-legged friend to feed on natural products and entertain themselves with original games.
A shop full of originality and great advice 👍🫶 …

A fantastic shop! They have everything you need: kibble, treats, toys, accessories… I buy treats for my fur babies, and they absolutely love them! The staff is welcoming, helpful, and you can tell they genuinely love animals. Plus, they also offer dog training services. I highly recommend it!
Ali Baba's cave, you can find everything from toys to pet food.
This is the shop where I find everything I need for my dog, with great advice from Valérie! I recommend it 100%!

Valérie has been working with Volt for the past six months and has been a great support and companion when he broke his leg. The group and individual lessons have allowed us to learn how to work effectively with Volt and have given him a solid foundation in training. Valérie is a good listener and also knows how to speak up when someone isn't doing their job properly ;-)

A lovely shop with a great selection of toys for enrichment and training. They also have many natural chew toys and plenty of healthy snacks – it's fantastic! Our Australian Shepherd loves them. Plus, Valérie is always available to advise us based on our dog's needs.
Superb shop with lots of choices for dogs and cats and Valérie is always there to give us good advice!
An Alibaba cave for our four-legged friends. Valerie knows her products perfectly and gives us sound advice; there's no need to stress about choosing this shop.
Good articles and excellent advice tailored to each dog
My first visit but certainly not the last! A great selection of treats of all kinds for our four-legged friends and very good advice from the manager who is also a trainer.

We discovered Valérie's shop through her dog training classes and were able to find some great products for our Australian Shepherd and benefit from Valérie's advice. A very important detail: Valérie offers a toy loan service for a few weeks, which is fantastic for discovering new educational toys and rotating them to prevent the dog from getting bored with the same toys!
Superb shop! Valérie gives excellent advice for your dogs. She listens carefully to your needs. This is a place that deserves to be known. See you soon!

A superb shop with a huge selection for all your furry friends, whether dogs or cats. But the most amazing thing about this shop is the owner, who gives excellent advice, takes the time to listen to your needs, and shares her expertise regarding your pets' requirements. She's always kind and, above all, her prices are fair, which isn't always the case in other shops. Go there without hesitation; I only buy treats for my little Blue there, and she can attest to their quality. 😋
I discovered this shop a few weeks ago; it has a very wide selection, and the manager is attentive and very pleasant—you could chat with her for hours. I highly recommend it!
A very good experience with my little dog, who worked well and learned lots of things with great pleasure. I recommend it 🐾 …
Excellent listening skills and very professional, I highly recommend them

I went to the Canid'élire pet store because I was looking for toys to keep my puppy entertained. I was very pleasantly surprised by the huge selection of toys and the variety of chew toys available. I'd like to thank Valérie, who gave me excellent advice. The toys I bought perfectly met my expectations. In addition, I learned things I didn't know thanks to her guidance. Furthermore, she's a very professional trainer with gentle methods and a great understanding of dogs. I highly recommend her.

Fantastic shop with a huge selection of dog and cat supplies, a refreshing change from the usual shops. Valérie is very attentive; she took the time to advise me and give me tips for my dogs. A highly professional trainer who is passionate about what she does!
Valérie is very professional and loves dogs; she truly practices positive reinforcement training at its best – nothing better for your furry friends.

We discovered the shop while taking puppy classes with Valerie, and I'm thrilled with it. The shop offers a wide selection of high-quality dog ​​treats and kibble. What I particularly liked was the option to buy or rent toys for my puppy – a really practical and original idea. Valerie is incredibly friendly and always offers great advice. She takes the time to answer all my questions and recommend the best products for my pup. It's a real pleasure to shop here; I highly recommend it!

Valérie's shop is fantastic and sells all sorts of things for dogs (and cats, too!). They have treats, games, toys, natural food, collars, and more. Milou especially loves the pretzels!

And what's more, they have a toy library where you can borrow enrichment games for a low price. This way, dogs can regularly try out different games and develop their skills.
Milou's visit to the shop 🫶 …
Great shop, the only one in Marseille to sell Animalin harnesses (the best).
Great shop! That's where we buy treats and accessories for our Chihuahua, thanks to Valérie's advice. The inexpensive rental toys keep our dog entertained every day.

I am extremely satisfied with her services for my dog. Her gentle and effective methods have allowed my dog ​​to make impressive progress in a very short time. I particularly appreciated her personalized approach and attentive listening, …
A little shop you absolutely must know about, run by an exceptionally kind lady who loves dogs as much as people. A wonderful find!
A fantastic little shop, the kind you rarely find. Great advice and a whole range of educational games.
